versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart H — Electrical Wiring Interconnection System
versions.text: protection; EWIS (See AMC 25.1723) EWIS components must be considered to be a potential ignition source in each area where flammable fluid or vapours might escape by leakage of a fluid system and must meet the requirements of CS 25.863.
